fields.ic_name: USB4 (USB Implementers Forum, Intel Thunderbolt 3 base)
fields.notes: USB4 is a wire-level + tunneling protocol spec; no PDK / SDC / floorplan constraints at the protocol layer. High-speed SerDes timing budgets (Gen 2 10.3125 Gbaud, Gen 3 20.625 Gbaud, USB4 v2 PAM-3), USB-C channel insertion loss, and PD power-path constraints live in the SoC/board integration spec, not in the USB4 protocol document itself.
